You are an agent who can operate an Android phone on behalf of a user. Based on user's goal/request, you may
- Answer back if the request/goal is a question (or a chat message), like user asks "What is my schedule for today?".
- Complete some tasks described in the requests/goals by performing actions (step by step) on the phone.

When given a user request, you will try to complete it step by step. At each step, a list of descriptions for most UI elements on the current screen will be given to you (each element can be specified by an index), together with a history of what you have done in previous steps. Based on these pieces of information and the goal, you must choose to perform one of the action in the following list (action description followed by the JSON format) by outputing the action in the correct JSON format.
- If you think the task has been completed, finish the task by using the status action with complete as goal_status: `{"action_type": "status", "goal_status": "complete"}`
- If you think the task is not feasible (including cases like you don't have enough information or can not perform some necessary actions), finish by using the `status` action with infeasible as goal_status: `{"action_type": "status", "goal_status": "infeasible"}`
- Answer user's question: `{"action_type": "answer", "text": "<answer_text>"}`
- Click/tap on a UI element (specified by its index) on the screen: `{"action_type": "click", "index": <target_index>}`.
- Long press on a UI element (specified by its index) on the screen: `{"action_type": "long_press", "index": <target_index>}`.
- Type text into an editable text field (specified by its index), this action contains clicking the text field, typing in the text and pressing the enter, so no need to click on the target field to start: `{"action_type": "input_text", "text": <text_input>, "index": <target_index>}`
- Press the Enter key: `{"action_type": "keyboard_enter"}`
- Navigate to the home screen: `{"action_type": "navigate_home"}`
- Navigate back: `{"action_type": "navigate_back"}`
- Scroll the screen or a scrollable UI element in one of the four directions, use the same numeric index as above if you want to scroll a specific UI element, leave it empty when scroll the whole screen: `{"action_type": "scroll", "direction": <up, down, left, right>, "index": <optional_target_index>}`
- Open an app (nothing will happen if the app is not installed): `{"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": <name>}`
- Wait for the screen to update: `{"action_type": "wait"}`

The current user goal/request is: Delete the following recipes from Broccoli app: Quick Fried Rice, Tomato Basil Bruschetta, Pan-Seared Salmon with Quinoa.

Here is a history of what you have done so far:
Step 1: Action selected: {"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": "Broccoli"}. Opened Broccoli app; now on Recipes list showing Baked Cod, BBQ Chicken Quesadillas, Beef Stir Fry, Butternut Squash Soup, Caprese Salad Skewers, Cauliflower Fried "Rice". Need to scroll to find Quick Fried Rice, Tomato Basil Bruschetta, and Pan-Seared Salmon with Quinoa to delete them.
Step 2: Action selected: {"action_type": "scroll", "direction": "down", "index": 4}. Scrolled down the recipes list in Broccoli app to look for target recipes (Quick Fried Rice, Tomato Basil Bruschetta, Pan-Seared Salmon with Quinoa); list now shows recipes starting from Cauliflower Fried "Rice" through Eggplant Parmesan. Need to continue scrolling down to find the target recipes (P for Pan-Seared, Q for Quick, T for Tomato).
Step 3: Action selected: {"action_type": "scroll", "direction": "down", "index": 4}. Scrolled down the recipe list in Broccoli app to find target recipes; list now shows recipes from Eggplant Parmesan to Mango Chicken Curry. Need to continue scrolling to find Pan-Seared Salmon, Quick Fried Rice, and Tomato Basil Bruschetta.
Step 4: Action selected: {"action_type": "scroll", "direction": "down", "index": 4}. Scrolled down the recipes list in Broccoli app; now Pan-Seared Salmon with Quinoa and Quick Fried Rice are visible, but Tomato Basil Bruschetta is not yet shown—may need to scroll further after handling these two.
Step 5: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 16}. Clicked on "Pan-Seared Salmon with Quinoa" recipe (index 16) from the recipes list to open its detail page for deletion; the screen changed (recipe list no longer visible), suggesting the recipe detail page opened. Next, I should find and tap a delete/menu option to remove it. Remaining recipes to delete after this: Quick Fried Rice, Tomato Basil Bruschetta.
Step 6: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 6}. Clicked "More options" on the Pan-Seared Salmon with Quinoa recipe detail page; a menu appeared with Share, Share as file, Edit, and Delete options. Next, click "Delete" to remove this recipe.
Step 7: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 3}. Clicked Delete in the recipe options menu for Pan-Seared Salmon with Quinoa; a confirmation dialog "Delete this recipe?" now appears with CANCEL and DELETE buttons — need to click DELETE to confirm.
Step 8: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 2}. Clicked DELETE to confirm deletion of Pan-Seared Salmon with Quinoa; recipe list now shows remaining recipes (Mango Chicken Curry, Moroccan Chickpea Stew, Pesto Pasta with Peas, Quick Fried Rice, Quinoa Salad, Raspberry Almond Smoothie). Still need to delete Quick Fried Rice and Tomato Basil Bruschetta (need to scroll to find the latter).
Step 9: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 20}. Clicked on "Quick Fried Rice" recipe title (index 20) from the recipe list; successfully opened its detail page. Next, I should tap the "More options" (index 6) to find the delete option.
Step 10: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 6}. Clicked "More options" (index 6) on the Quick Fried Rice detail page; a menu appeared with Share, Share as file, Edit, and Delete options. Next, click "Delete" to remove this recipe.
Step 11: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 3}. Clicked "Delete" option in the recipe menu for Quick Fried Rice; a confirmation dialog "Delete this recipe?" appeared with CANCEL and DELETE buttons. Next, I should click DELETE to confirm.
Step 12: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 2}. Clicked DELETE to confirm deletion of Quick Fried Rice; the confirmation dialog closed and the recipe list no longer shows Quick Fried Rice. Next, I need to delete Tomato Basil Bruschetta and Pan-Seared Salmon with Quinoa (neither is visible in current view, may need to scroll).
Step 13: Action selected: {"action_type": "scroll", "direction": "down", "index": 4}. Scrolled down the recipe list to find Tomato Basil Bruschetta; the list advanced (now showing Salmon with Dill Sauce, Shrimp Avocado Salad, Spicy Tuna Wraps, Spinach and Feta Stuffed Chicken, Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos, Thai Peanut Noodle Salad), but Tomato Basil Bruschetta not yet visible—need to continue scrolling down.
Step 14: Action selected: {"action_type": "scroll", "direction": "down", "index": 4}. Scrolled down the recipe list to find "Tomato Basil Bruschetta"; it's now visible in the list (around the middle of the screen), ready to be tapped to open and delete it.
Step 15: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 16}. Clicked on "Tomato Basil Bruschetta" (index 16) in the recipes list, which successfully opened its detail page. Now I need to tap "More options" (index 6) to find the delete option.
Step 16: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 6}. Tapped "More options" (index 6) on the Tomato Basil Bruschetta detail page; a menu appeared with Share, Share as file, Edit, and Delete options — next, tap "Delete" to remove this recipe.
Step 17: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 3}. Clicked Delete (index 3) in the recipe options menu for Tomato Basil Bruschetta; a confirmation dialog "Delete this recipe?" now appears with CANCEL and DELETE buttons — need to click DELETE to confirm.
Step 18: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 2}. Clicked DELETE to confirm deletion of Tomato Basil Bruschetta; the confirmation dialog closed and returned to the recipe list, which no longer shows Tomato Basil Bruschetta, Quick Fried Rice, or Pan-Seared Salmon with Quinoa—all three target recipes appear deleted successfully.

General

- If the desired state is already achieved (e.g., enabling Wi-Fi when it's already on), you can just complete the task.
